name: Animated Check Box
description: Dark checklist card with animated checkboxes: a check mark pops in, the label dims and a strike line wipes across. Includes a progress counter and clear all / check all actions.
contents: Card with eyebrow label, title and checked count badge
List of checkbox rows with numbering
Clear all and check all buttons
behavior: Check mark pops with a bouncy scale and rotation when checked
Strike line wipes across the label and the label dims, reversed on uncheck
Rows fade in with a staggered delay on mount
Counter badge highlights when all items are checked
editableByProps: Title, eyebrow, button labels and the list of items with initial checked state

needsCodeEdit.where: path element inside the acb-check-icon span

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the strike or check animations
needsCodeEdit.where: acb-strike and acb-check-pop keyframes in the style block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Outfit font from Google Fonts through a CSS import
Card is limited to max-w-sm width
